Question: Why do Indian summer vegetables taste so horrible?
Answer: Indian summer vegetables include.. Bitter gourd, bottle gourd, ash gourd, snake gourd, onion, ridge gourd, cucumber, gherkins, drumstick, chillies, plantain okra, pumpkin, most greens, cluster beans, squash, tomato and brinjals. Summer fruits include palm fruit, coconut, water melon, musk melon, bananas and mangoes. These are called Indian vegetables and fruits in contrast to English vegetables or the winter vegetables like potato, cauliflower, cabbage, carrot, beans, broccoli, knolkhol, spinach, turnip, capsicum, beetroot , curry beans, broad beans, radish, peas, corm, colocasia, corn etc. Summer vegetables are all juicy and watery, filled with liquid as the environment is hot and dry. The plants store water in vegetables and fruits as a natural adaptation in summer. When you cook and eat them you get the benefits of water to cool your body from summer heat. They are low calorie food wise and seem like “a diluted version” of usual vegetables with no sugary, salty, pungent or sour tastes in them . These are not starchy store rooms or gas producing cylinders. They keep the body free from sunstroke, heat allergies, prickly heat, heat boils, gas problems and help us to reduce our body weight. There keep us free from gas problem, chest aches or “air locks” in our intestines as they get digested and egested easily. Many people find healthy summer vegetables boring and bland. There is no good taste in them but we can add various ingredients to make them tasty. The large water content in them keeps our body cool and weight in check and they are easy for digestion. They keep our kidneys functioning well. They do not cause obesity and other weight related health issues. They keep our BP down as they remove excess salt from our body. 1.5.24

Question: What are 10 things you wish you knew in your 20s?
Answer: Flash back to mid 80s Relatives cannot be trusted. Never leave your adult children in relative’s houses nor give their names as guardians of your college +hostel staying teen children. Relatives will only speak ill of you given the first opportunity. Especially so if you /your parents are doing well. Even the most self- reliant person needs friends when sick especially those in hostels with parents far away. Should have worked harder on my organic chemistry lessons. Needed lots of formulae and equation memorizing. Should have taken part seriously in some form of NCC in those college years . Not bunked classes especially practicals which are never done again like those involving proteins in the frog liver and analysing the chromatography bands etc Should have respected all professors equally. I had some favourites. Should not have trusted all my friends /classmates so much . Some turned out to be betrayers. There was a cut throat competition in college /univ level itself. Should have eaten healthy food. I was very choosy and avoided many of the hostel mess prepared dishes. Should have been more careful in spending father's hard earned money. 24.3.24

Question: I’ve been with my guy for 8 years? He is now saying we are not compatible in bed and he no longer wants to marry me. He says he doesn’t want to leave me and he won’t. What would you do if your parter said this to you after dating 8 years?
Answer: Not compatible in bed, after 8 years.. Wow what a quick realization ! After 8 years if somebody says this it shows nothing but betrayal of trust. He is a cheater. He wants a change of person, bed and variety in his partners . Some men want a change in everything. There is no love left in here. But the most obvious reason is somebody has already replaced you. This is true of all relationships which break whether husband wife, bf - gf, BFF, live in, friends, project mates etc. The main reason is you are out , someone else is in. Or even more than one. Not what do you do when confronted by such a betrayal ? Your self respect says leave that relationship immediately. No point convincing, begging, threatening to become a better person in bed , in this case “learning” how to be more compatible. (by trying out more positions ?) Eeks.. So you get out or throw the person out. Change your place of stay. Change your door locks. Throw all his things out. What if the person used (abused) you for 8 years promising marriage but it was actually only for free sex, your money, accommodation ? Many people in your life already know you were together for 8 years. So it isn't a secret any more to sweep it under the carpet easily and move on smiling fakely . So now you use the “ female favouring laws” of your country and file a Rape complaint and betrayal after promising marriage, in the local police station, preferably an all women police station for faster results. Now why he says he doesn't want to leave, he won't etc …? This is to stop you from filing a complaint against him. It is obvious he is protecting himself while jumping into new beds. Next take an advocate ‘s help to claim a fat compensation for time lost, youth lost, money spent, mental torture and even physical abuse. Whether he wins or you win atleast it will do enough damage to his reputation. This will satisfy your soul and give you a good closure to this relationship. Only then you will feel relieved and be able to move on with a light heart. 3.6.24

Question: What are five things senior citizens should not do at the age of 65 and over?
Answer: I am not of that age, my husband is but moving with such people in my relatives and friends circle I have these to say Do not retire from life even if retired from your full time jobs. Take up easy jobs, if you want too. Take up hobbies, go shopping, watch tv, see movies, tour, talk to friends etc Have something as good time pass. This helps to keep your mind busy and happy. It keeps you physically fit too. Do not be in a hurry to divide and give away your property and wealth to your adult children. You can write a will though and keep it safe. Your adult children can earn their own money. Easy money has no value. Besides you giving them away is like giving away your self respect and your future security. Money in hand keeps you self reliant. Depending on children for money is a curse. Do not neglect yourself. Take care of your health. Take care your diet. Do simple exercises . Being mobile is a blessing. Go for walks. Do not complain about your various aches and pains. Nobody is interested nor willing to care for you. They do not have time for elder people care even if parents / inlaws Avoid unnecessary hospital visits. Do not give advice to anybody unless asked for. Even if they are going wrong let them learn from their mistakes. They will hate you for advising and only laugh at your advice. Besides they think they know everything thanks to Google, perplexity etc. Do not be over inquisitive about others’ lives. Never ask anyone personal questions. Avoid loose talk or giving suggestions to them (your adult children etc), on their increasing body weight, their gadget addiction, spending meaninglessly, not saving money, about not eating healthy food and how to care for their general health. Adult children hate these topics and see us as enemies or irritating / boring preachers ! But often mothers like me get away with such (harsh) advice because if we mothers don't tell then who will ? So talk to them and not about them. Do not idle away your time. Travel to keep yourself busy. Go on package tours well arranged by experienced travel agents....

Question: Is it considered acceptable to take grandchildren out of school for a family vacation?
Answer: Depends on what grade they are in. In India 10th, 12 th grade students should attend school on all days so that they do not miss out on any important lessons, practice tests or practical work. They face public exams in these classes. Other class children taking a few days off is okay with permission from the school authorities and a proper reason.. Like a wedding in the family or reunion day. Simply going on a vacation for 10 days, when the school has just reopened after a long summer or winter vacation is never appreciated by teachers. 24.12.23
